piezas.titulo: Reading words: Recounting an experience and ordering events
texto: Reading and spelling of formal narrative terms: «ประสบการณ์» is a learned word of Sanskrit origin made of «ประสบ» (bprà-sòp, to experience / to encounter, with the final บ in แม่กบ, low tone) and «การณ์» with the vowel า, the retroflex consonant ร and the final ณ silenced with the thantakhat sign (การันต์). «เหตุการณ์» has «เหตุ» (hèet, cause / reason, written with ห, the vowel เ, and the final consonant ตุ, with the vowel ุ silent, pronounced simply as [t]) followed by «การณ์». «ในที่สุด» combines «ใน» (the diphthong ใ), «ที่» (falling tone) and «สุด» (low tone).

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ระหว่างทางเกิดเหตุขัดข้องทางเทคนิค ทำให้ต้องแวะพักเพื่อแก้ไขสถานการณ์» express?

opciones.texto: During the journey a technical fault arose, forcing an unplanned stop.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ระหว่างทางเกิดเหตุขัดข้องทางเทคนิค ทำให้ต้องแวะพักเพื่อแก้ไขสถานการณ์» from the text.

opciones.texto: After coordinating with local mechanics, the vehicle was ready to continue.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Finally, the expedition reached its destination as planned.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «เหตุการณ์» (event / occurrence), how is the initial syllable «เหตุ» pronounced?

opciones.texto: As [hèet], with low tone and the vowel ุ silent before the final stop [t]
opciones.explicacion: Correct: in the Sanskrit-origin word เหตุ, the spelling ตุ acts as a voiceless final consonant [t].
Incorrect: in standard Thai it is not pronounced as two independent syllables.
Incorrect: the written vowel is เ and the final consonant is a stop.
